plugins.name: fullstack-agents
plugins.description: AI-powered polyglot fullstack toolkit: 29 agents, 8 commands, and 25 skill domains for FastAPI and Rust/Axum microservices behind one Next.js frontend. Clean architecture + DDD in both languages, strict language-lane separation, spec-kit-compatible project constitutions, and hard enforcement hooks (prompt re-arming, pre-edit blocking gate, post-edit and stop validation).
